extracted.intended_audience: beginning and more accomplished writers aiming to write and publish romance novels
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for crafting and publishing romance novels, covering character creation, plotting and pacing, genre conventions, manuscript preparation, submission, marketing, and contract negotiation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create the perfect heroes and heroines
rubrics_metrics.description: How to create the perfect heroes and heroines for a romance novel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Book promises to teach what it takes to create compelling protagonists; included among the building blocks of a great romance and elements to hook readers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Select a pseudonym
rubrics_metrics.description: Guidance on choosing a pseudonym for publication.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Listed as a practical consideration for authors in the romance market (e.g., selecting a pseudonym before publishing).

rubrics_metrics.name: Write a compelling, heartfelt story
rubrics_metrics.description: Craft a story that is emotionally engaging and sincere.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Advice to write with passion and to hook the reader from page one; described as a central goal for romance novels.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find the right agent and publisher
rubrics_metrics.description: How to identify and approach appropriate literary agents and publishers for your romance novel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical guidance on analyzing the marketplace and finding the right agent/publisher relationships for successful submission and sale.

rubrics_metrics.name: Submit a manuscript
rubrics_metrics.description: Preparation and process for submitting your manuscript to agents or publishers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes manuscript preparation checklist and tips for shaping a proposal that will 'wow agents and editors.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Market your novel
rubrics_metrics.description: Strategies and actions to promote and sell your published romance novel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Book promises savvy pointers on marketing as part of becoming a published novelist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Join clubs and associations
rubrics_metrics.description: Use professional and community organizations to support writing and publishing efforts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Recommended as one of the practical steps authors can take to advance their careers and connect with the romance community.

rubrics_metrics.name: Hook the reader from page one
rubrics_metrics.description: Craft an opening that immediately engages readers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly noted as a skill the book helps develop—part of 'how to hook your reader from page one.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Write with passion
rubrics_metrics.description: Ensure the prose conveys emotional intensity appropriate for romance.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Emphasized alongside hooking the reader and creating heartfelt stories; a stylistic aim for romance authors.

rubrics_metrics.name: Shape a proposal that will wow agents and editors
rubrics_metrics.description: Construct submission materials (proposal/query) that impress industry professionals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Book promises concrete tips on proposal-shaping for submission success, included in the manuscript/submission guidance.

rubrics_metrics.name: Analyze the marketplace
rubrics_metrics.description: Research and understand current trends, subgenres, and market demand for romance fiction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Described as 'lots of expert tips on analyzing the marketplace' to help writers place and pitch their work effectively.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create compelling characters and find your voice
rubrics_metrics.description: Develop strong characterizations and an individual narrative voice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The book offers help on creating compelling characters and finding your own voice as a novelist.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understand romance sub-genres
rubrics_metrics.description: Know the conventions and expectations of romance sub-genres (historical, contemporary, multicultural, paranormal, romantic suspense, Christian/inspirational).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The book 'demystifies the sub-genres of the romance world' and lists major sub-genres to help authors choose and conform to—or innovate within—market categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plotting
rubrics_metrics.description: Design an effective plot structure for a romance novel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Book 'explains plotting' as a core craft element for romance writers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Pacing
rubrics_metrics.description: Manage narrative momentum and timing to sustain reader interest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Included with plotting and love-scene advice; pacing guidance helps maintain engagement across the novel.

rubrics_metrics.name: Write crucial love scenes
rubrics_metrics.description: Compose intimate scenes that are convincing, appropriate to the subgenre, and advance character/plot.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The book explicitly addresses 'writing those crucial love scenes'—how to handle them for impact and market expectations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Conduct research, assign credits, and get permissions
rubrics_metrics.description: Perform necessary research and handle attribution and permissions for copyrighted or factual material used in the novel.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Practical legal and research-related advice: how to conduct research, how to assign credits, and how to obtain permissions when needed.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decide whether to write alone or with a partner
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluate the pros and cons of solo vs. collaborative writing for your project.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The book 'helps you decide whether it's best to write alone or with a partner,' offering considerations for collaboration.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manuscript preparation checklist
rubrics_metrics.description: Follow formatting and submission-preparation steps before sending work to agents/publishers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes a complete manuscript preparation checklist to ensure a professional submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Revision techniques
rubrics_metrics.description: Approaches and tips for revising the manuscript smoothly and successfully.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Offers specific tips for revising work to improve quality and readiness for submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Understand and negotiate contracts
rubrics_metrics.description: Knowledge and strategies for interpreting and negotiating publishing contracts.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides guidance in understanding and negotiating a contract as part of the publishing process.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use lists of romance writing resources
rubrics_metrics.description: Consult recommended resources, organizations, and references to support craft and career development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Book includes a list of romance writing resources to help writers continue learning and networking.
